title: Update UI to match provided reference pages, apply referenced Ludo design style, and remove 'Create Game' UI

requirements.text: Update the Home screen UI layout and styling to closely match the look/structure shown in the uploaded reference image (Screenshot_20260131_000048.jpg): a clean top header, a prominent hero section with a centered device/phone mock image, and large, bold headline + subheadline text; keep the existing ability to navigate into Ludo/Chess/Carrom/Cricket via the existing onSelectGame(game) flow.

quotes: I need this kind of ui Page exist content

acceptanceCriteria: HomeScreen remains the app landing screen and still allows entering each of the four game modes using the existing onSelectGame(game) callback.
HomeScreen hero section is visually reworked to resemble the reference: header + prominent hero image + headline + subheadline, and is responsive for mobile widths.
Any user-facing text added/modified for this change is in English.

requirements.text: Apply the visual style shown in the uploaded reference image (Screenshot_20260129_125437.jpg) to the Ludo game experience: use a modern glassmorphism look (blurred/soft gradient background, translucent rounded card panels, strong primary CTA button) for the Ludo pre-game setup screen and in-game HUD panels, without changing Ludo gameplay rules.

quotes: 2nd one is ludo design I need that kind of design

acceptanceCriteria: LudoScreen (both the pre-game setup state and active game state) uses a glassmorphism-styled layout (translucent panels, rounded corners, subtle blur/gradient background).
Ludo gameplay (dice roll, turn logic, piece movement, win detection) behaves exactly as before; only UI/visual presentation changes.
Any user-facing text added/modified for this change is in English.

requirements.text: Remove the 'Create Game' option from the app UI wherever it appears (buttons, menus, headings, or navigation actions), ensuring users can still start local games via existing 'Start Game/New Game/Quick Play' flows.

quotes: remove create game I don't need and want

acceptanceCriteria: No visible UI element in the app contains the label 'Create Game'.
Users can still start and replay games in all modes (Ludo/Chess/Carrom/Cricket) using the existing local-play flows.
No backend changes are required for this removal.

requirements.text: Add new static visual assets to support the updated Home hero and Ludo glassmorphism styling, store them under frontend/public/assets/generated, and wire the updated screens to use them directly from that folder.
acceptanceCriteria: All newly generated images are saved under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced via /assets/generated/... paths (no backend image serving).
HomeScreen and LudoScreen successfully load and render the newly added assets without broken links.

constraints: Frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui must not be edited directly; compose them instead.

Frontend files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, and frontend/src/main.tsx are immutable and must not be modified.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not implement phone-number/password based authentication or a 'Create Account' system (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
Do not add real-time multiplayer or online matchmaking.
Do not change the rules/logic of any game mode; this request is UI/visual-design focused.

required: Soft gradient background with subtle bokeh/light streaks (ludo-glass-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Centered smartphone device mock with a generic Ludo-themed screen (home-hero-phone.dim_900x900.png)
Abstract soft gradient texture for glass panels (glass-panel-texture.dim_1200x800.png)

preferencesToAdd: User prefers UI styled to match provided reference screenshots; wants glassmorphism style for Ludo and removal of 'Create Game' UI.
